records.l: Shaggy Man, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seven
records.s: Shaggy Man invites Polychrome to join the travelers and uses the Love Magnet to make her love him. He investigates the well, recognizes the recovered copper man as his old friend Tik-Tok, and learns that his brother is imprisoned in Ruggedo's cavern.

records.l: Ruggedo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seven
records.s: Ruggedo is also called the Nome King and the Metal Monarch. He knows that Tik-Tok was sent to help find Shaggy Man's brother and throws Tik-Tok into an old well.

records.l: the Nome King's cavern, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seven
records.s: The cavern lies beneath the earth's surface, where the Rainbow cannot penetrate. Its entrances are hidden by Ruggedo, so the travelers may find their way there only by chance.

records.l: the Ugly One, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seven
records.s: Shaggy Man's brother is being held prisoner in the Nome King's cavern. Tik-Tok confirms that he is there after seeing him through Ozma's magic picture.

records.l: Tik-Tok, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seven
records.s: Tik-Tok is recovered from an old well after Shaggy Man and Betsy pull up his copper body. Once his thought, speech, and action mechanisms are wound, he explains that Ozma sent him to guide and help Shaggy Man, but Ruggedo threw him into the well.

records.l: the adventurers, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seven
records.s: The travelers' party consists of Betsy Bobbin, Hank, the Princess, Shaggy Man, and later Polychrome and Tik-Tok. They search for Shaggy Man's brother, become lost while seeking Ruggedo's cavern, recover Tik-Tok, and face the approach of an army at a crossroads.

records.l: Tik-Tok of Oz, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eight
records.s: Queen Ann Soforth and the Army of Oogaboo arrive to conquer Shaggy Man and his companions, but Hank scatters the officers and Private Files refuses to bind the girls. Shaggy uses the Love Magnet to turn the Oogabooites into his friends and proposes that they help conquer Ruggedo and rescue Shaggy's brother. The officers make Tik-Tok their private soldier, and he accepts after being promised a share of the plunder. Princess Ozga asks the flowers for directions, and they indicate the road to Ruggedo's underground kingdom.

records.l: Shaggy Man, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eight
records.s: Shaggy introduces his companions to Queen Ann and tells her that Ruggedo should be conquered. He uses the Love Magnet to win the friendship of the Army of Oogaboo, then offers its members the plunder from Ruggedo's kingdom if they help rescue his brother.

records.l: Tik-Tok, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eight
records.s: Tik-Tok refuses at first to become the Oogaboo Army's private soldier because he cannot fight or run reliably when his works run down. He agrees after Betsy promises to keep him wound up, and he receives a gun, a knapsack, and a share of the plunder.

records.l: Rose Princess, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eight
records.s: Princess Ozga is introduced as an exiled princess. At Private Files's suggestion, she asks the roadside flowers which way leads to Ruggedo's kingdom, and they bend and nod toward the correct road.

records.l: Polychrome, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eight
records.s: Polychrome is introduced as a sky fairy who lost her Bow and cannot find her way home. She dances with glee when Hank routs the Army of Oogaboo and suggests that Tik-Tok could carry the soldiers' gun.

records.l: Betsy Bobbin, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eight
records.s: Betsy objects when Queen Ann claims that her party has been conquered and refuses to become anyone's slave. She restrains Hank by his forelock and promises to keep Tik-Tok wound up if he becomes a soldier.

records.l: Hank, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eight
records.s: Hank attacks the Army of Oogaboo by backing into the officers and kicking at them, scattering them and making them drop their swords. Betsy later holds him back by his forelock.

records.l: Queen Ann, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eight
records.s: Queen Ann claims the territory for Oogaboo and orders her army to bind Shaggy's companions, but Hank defeats the attack and Private Files resigns. The Love Magnet makes her forget her anger and embrace Shaggy, after which she joins the plan to conquer Ruggedo.

records.l: Files, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eight
records.s: Private Files plants the banner of Oogaboo and announces the conquest, but he refuses to bind the girls because it would be impolite. He resigns rather than obey Queen Ann's order and later proposes making Tik-Tok the Army's private soldier.

records.l: Army of Oogaboo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eight
records.s: The Army of Oogaboo arrives intending to conquer Shaggy and his companions, but Hank routs its officers. After seeing the Love Magnet, its members become Shaggy's firm friends and agree to help conquer Ruggedo, with Tik-Tok replacing Private Files as the private soldier.

records.l: Ruggedo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eight
records.s: Ruggedo is identified as the Metal Monarch and King of the Nomes. Shaggy says that Ruggedo owns the underground metal and that conquering him would provide the Army of Oogaboo with great riches.

records.l: the Nome Kingdom, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eight
records.s: The underground Kingdom of Ruggedo is the destination toward which Shaggy and the Army of Oogaboo plan to march. The party initially does not know which road leads there, but the flowers indicate the way.

records.l: Love Magnet, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eight
records.s: The Love Magnet causes everyone in the Army of Oogaboo, including Queen Ann, to love Shaggy and abandon their hostility. Shaggy hides it in his pocket after Queen Ann embraces him.

records.l: the Oogaboo expedition to conquer the world, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eight
records.s: The proposed conquest of Ruggedo is meant to help Shaggy rescue his brother while allowing Queen Ann and her officers to claim the kingdom's gold, jewels, and other plunder. The plan begins when Tik-Tok accepts the role of private soldier and the flowers reveal the road to Ruggedo's kingdom.

records.l: Tik-Tok of Oz, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: The adventurers approach Ruggedo's Nome Kingdom, crossing the Rubber Country and overcoming its strange rubber terrain and dry water. Ruggedo learns through Kaliko and the Long-Eared Hearer that Shaggy Man seeks the Ugly One and that the Army of Oogaboo plans to seize the kingdom's metals and jewels. Enraged, Ruggedo orders Kaliko and the Chief Magician to redirect the path toward the invisible Hollow Tube, despite warnings that this will anger Tititi-Hoochoo. Kaliko obeys but privately prepares letters of recommendation because he believes Ruggedo has ruined himself.

records.l: Ruggedo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: Ruggedo rules the Nome Kingdom as the Monarch of the Metals and Precious Stones. He becomes enraged when the adventurers approach, decides to drop them down the Hollow Tube, and defies warnings that Tititi-Hoochoo will punish him.

records.l: Kaliko, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: Kaliko serves as Ruggedo's High Chamberlain and uses a magic spyglass to observe the approaching adventurers. He warns Ruggedo about Tititi-Hoochoo, obeys the order to redirect the path to the Hollow Tube, and privately writes letters of recommendation because he expects Ruggedo's decision to ruin him.

records.l: the adventurers, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: The adventurers travel toward the Nome Kingdom and pass through the Rubber Country despite Ruggedo's efforts to hinder them. They include Tik-Tok, Queen Ann, the Army of Oogaboo, the Shaggy Man, the Rose Princess, Polychrome, Betsy Bobbin, Hank, and Files.

records.l: the Nome Kingdom, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: The Nome Kingdom lies beneath the mountains and contains Ruggedo's jeweled cavern, countless nomes, and great stores of metals and precious stones. The approaching adventurers intend to enter it, while Ruggedo seeks to prevent them.

records.l: the nomes, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: The nomes work in the caverns by hammering metals, melting ores, and polishing gems. They tremble when Ruggedo's gong sounds but continue working because none dares pause.

records.l: Tik-Tok, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: Tik-Tok steps onto a rubber stepping-stone and is launched into the air, flipping from one rubber rock to another before eventually rejoining the party. Ruggedo says he had previously thrown Tik-Tok down a well, but Kaliko indicates that someone pulled him out.

records.l: Queen Ann, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: Queen Ann becomes angry when the officers of the Army of Oogaboo are bounced around by the rubber terrain. She and her officers initially hesitate to cross the stream but later cross with the rest of the party by wading through the dry water.

records.l: Army of Oogaboo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: The Army of Oogaboo travels with its officers and Queen Ann toward the Nome Kingdom. According to the Long-Eared Hearer, it plans to capture the kingdom's metals and jewels and divide the spoils.

records.l: Polychrome, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: Polychrome is identified by Kaliko as the Rainbow's Daughter, whom a nome cannot injure. In the Rubber Country, she tests the rubber by dancing, bounds across the stream, and discovers that the water is dry.

records.l: Rose Princess, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: The Rose Princess travels near the rear of the party with Files. Kaliko suspects that she may be a fairy.

records.l: Betsy Bobbin, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: Betsy laughs at the officers' bouncing in the Rubber Country and uses Polychrome's suggestion to cross the brook by bouncing over it. She then calls Hank to follow her.

records.l: Hank, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: Hank tries to bounce across the brook but falls into the middle of it. He reaches the far bank and is found to be completely dry because the water is dry.

records.l: Shaggy Man, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: Shaggy Man explains that the rocks, stepping-stones, and path in the Rubber Country are rubber and warns the party that they may get the bounce. The Long-Eared Hearer learns that Shaggy Man is coming to rescue his brother, the Ugly One.

records.l: the Ugly One, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: The Ugly One is imprisoned by Ruggedo and has been sent to the Metal Forest. Ruggedo says Shaggy Man may have him, but believes the invaders will have difficulty finding the forest.

records.l: Tititi-Hoochoo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: Tititi-Hoochoo lives on the other side of the world and previously warned Ruggedo that he would take vengeance if Ruggedo again sent people through the Hollow Tube. Kaliko fears that Ruggedo's plan will make Tititi-Hoochoo angry.

records.l: Long-Eared Hearer, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: The Long-Eared Hearer listens for half an hour and reports that Shaggy Man seeks the Ugly One and that the Army of Oogaboo plans to raid the Nome Kingdom. Ruggedo cruelly pulls and twists his ears, but the Hearer escapes while Ruggedo chases Kaliko.

records.l: the Rubber Country, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: The Rubber Country contains gray rubber rocks, trees, paths, and stepping-stones that cause people who touch them to bounce. Its stream is dry water, allowing the adventurers to wade across without getting wet.

records.l: the Forbidden Tube, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: The Hollow Tube is a dangerous passage through which Ruggedo plans to drop the adventurers. At Ruggedo's order, the Chief Magician redirects the path toward its opening and makes the opening invisible.

records.l: Metal Forest, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: The Metal Forest was created by Ruggedo, who made every tree from gold and silver to keep precious metals away from mortals. The Ugly One has been sent there, but even Ruggedo says that he cannot always find it.

records.l: the adventurers' journey to the Nome Kingdom, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: The adventurers follow a winding route toward the mountains where the entrance to Ruggedo's cavern is located. They cross the Rubber Country and continue toward the Nome Kingdom despite Ruggedo's attempts to stop them.

records.l: the crossing of the Rubber Country, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: During the crossing, Tik-Tok and two officers are bounced by the rubber stepping-stones. Polychrome and Betsy Bobbin bound over the brook, Hank falls into the dry water, and the entire party eventually wades across and continues onward.

records.l: Ruggedo's rage, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: Ruggedo's rage begins when he senses mortals approaching his kingdom. He raves, kicks Kaliko, attacks the Long-Eared Hearer, chases Kaliko around the throne, and finally insists on using the Hollow Tube against the invaders.

records.l: the Army of Oogaboo's planned treasure raid, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: The Army of Oogaboo intends to capture the Nome Kingdom's rich metals and rare jewels. Its officers and Queen Ann have arranged to divide and carry away the spoils.

records.l: the attempted attack with the Hollow Tube, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nine
records.s: Ruggedo orders the adventurers' path to be turned toward the Hollow Tube so they will fall through its invisible opening. The plan is carried out by Kaliko and the Chief Magician, even though Kaliko warns that it defies Tititi-Hoochoo.

records.l: Tik-Tok of Oz, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Ten
records.s: Polychrome, Queen Ann, the Army of Oogaboo, Betsy Bobbin, Hank, Shaggy Man, Tik-Tok, Ozga, and Files are drawn into the Hollow Tube while traveling through Ruggedo's cavern. They slide for more than an hour through darkness and emerge on the opposite side of the world, where Tik-Tok falls into a fountain and Queen Ann collides with a Peculiar Person. Tubekins, a strange multicolored inhabitant, orders them to the Residence after learning that they intended to conquer Ruggedo. Invisible inhabitants assist and threaten the travelers, who finally follow Tubekins toward the castle.

records.l: Polychrome, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Ten
records.s: Polychrome travels through the Hollow Tube with the others and explains that it leads through the center of the earth. She says Ruggedo pushed them into the Tube, laughs during the frightening journey, and later helps identify their purpose as enemies of Ruggedo.

records.l: Queen Ann, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Ten
records.s: Queen Ann disappears into the Tube after the officers and is carried through it in a sitting position. She emerges by sailing through the air, lands on a Peculiar Person's head, and struggles with him until the officers separate them.

records.l: Army of Oogaboo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Ten
records.s: The Army of Oogaboo follows Tik-Tok into the Tube and slides down in a tangled crowd while its clanking swords strike and pummel the soldiers. The officers emerge in succession, help restrain the Peculiar Person, and later obey orders to follow Tubekins after invisible beings kick them.

records.l: Ruggedo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Ten
records.s: Ruggedo's Chief Magician has enchanted the pathway in Ruggedo's cavern. Polychrome says Ruggedo, the Nome King, pushed the travelers into the Hollow Tube, and Tubekins becomes excited when Ruggedo is mentioned.

records.l: Tik-Tok, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Ten
records.s: Tik-Tok disappears first and slides headfirst through the Hollow Tube on his back. He emerges into daylight and falls into a marble fountain, where invisible hands lift him out; after water disables his joints, Shaggy Man oils and dries him so he can move and speak again.

records.l: Betsy Bobbin, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Ten
records.s: Betsy rides Hank backward when the mule suddenly begins sliding down the Hollow Tube, and she holds tightly to his neck. She speaks with Queen Ann, Shaggy Man, and Polychrome during the journey, emerges safely, and explains to Tubekins that they arrived through the Hollow Tube.

records.l: Hank, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Ten
records.s: Hank pitches forward and slides rapidly down the Hollow Tube with Betsy clinging to his back. He cannot stop, but he lands on all four feet and is only slightly jarred; during the journey he gives a sympathetic 'Hee-haw!'

records.l: Shaggy Man, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Ten
records.s: Shaggy Man slides through the Hollow Tube with Polychrome and the others, briefly receiving her heel on his head and later her heel near his eye. He helps Tubekins remove the battered crown from his eyes and oils Tik-Tok after the copper man is lifted from the fountain.

records.l: the Forbidden Tube, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Ten
records.s: The Hollow Tube is a steep, smooth passage leading through the earth to the opposite side of the world. It carries the travelers at great speed for more than an hour before ejecting them into a garden.

records.l: Tubekins, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Ten
records.s: A Peculiar Person is hoeing pink violets in a garden when the travelers emerge. Queen Ann lands on his head and smashes a jeweled crown over his eyes; after the officers restrain him, he questions the travelers and identifies the Tube as private property.

records.l: invisible inhabitants, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Ten
records.s: Invisible inhabitants speak from the air, laugh at Tik-Tok's difficulty moving, lift him from the fountain, dry him with warm air, and provide an oil-can. They also shove Queen Ann and kick hesitant officers so that the group follows Tubekins.

records.l: journey through the Tube, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Ten
records.s: The journey through the Tube is dark, extremely fast, and frightening, though the travelers gradually recover enough to converse. After more than an hour, they reach daylight on the opposite side of the world.

records.l: the party's arrival through the Forbidden Tube, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Ten
records.s: The travelers fall into the Tube without realizing that danger lies in their pathway. They are unable to stop themselves and slide down the passage in separate groups and positions.

records.l: the country of the Private Citizen, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Ten
records.s: The travelers arrive in a beautiful garden with trees, shrubbery, and views of an immense castle. They encounter Tubekins, invisible inhabitants, and unfamiliar customs, and they follow Tubekins toward the castle because returning through the Tube seems undesirable.

records.l: Tik-Tok of Oz, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eleven
records.s: Betsy, Polychrome, and the rest of the party are brought before the Private Citizen, ruler of a land where all Kings and Queens are equal. Tik-Tok explains that Ruggedo forced them through the Forbidden Tube while they were seeking to free Shaggy's lost brother. The Private Citizen decides that the party is not guilty and orders that Ruggedo alone be punished, though he has not yet determined how. The travelers are assigned as guests to various palaces until they return to the Residence the next day.

records.l: Betsy Bobbin, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eleven
records.s: Betsy is brought before the Private Citizen with the party and identifies herself when questioned. She is worried when her companions react fearfully to the name of the Great Jinjin, but she remains curious about what will happen to Ruggedo. Queen Erma invites her to be a guest, and Betsy asks that Polychrome accompany her.

records.l: Polychrome, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eleven
records.s: Polychrome accompanies Betsy before the Private Citizen and is interested in the strange assembly of Kings and Queens. She becomes sober and uneasy when the Private Citizen is revealed to be Tititi-Hoochoo, the Great Jinjin. She is chosen to accompany Betsy as a guest of Queen Erma.

records.l: Tititi-Hoochoo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eleven
records.s: The Private Citizen is the supreme ruler of the land, where all Kings and Queens are equal before him. He learns from Tik-Tok that Ruggedo forced the party through the Forbidden Tube and decides that the travelers should be treated with justice rather than punished. He orders that the party be entertained as guests and says he will decide Ruggedo's fate before their return to the Residence.

records.l: Queen Ann of Oogaboo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eleven
records.s: Queen Ann claims leadership of the party, but the Private Citizen tells her to keep quiet and later recognizes Tik-Tok as the party's important private soldier instead. She becomes frightened and begins to tremble when she learns that the Private Citizen is Tititi-Hoochoo, the Great Jinjin.

records.l: Tik-Tok, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eleven
records.s: Tik-Tok identifies himself as the party's only private soldier and is respectfully invited to sit beside the Private Citizen on the throne. He explains the party's quest, their encounter with Ruggedo, and their forced passage through the Forbidden Tube. The Private Citizen declares that Tik-Tok's machinery prevents him from lying or thinking falsely and accepts his account as truthful.

records.l: Shaggy Man, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eleven
records.s: Shaggy Man is present with the party when it is brought before the Private Citizen. He is disturbed when he learns that the ruler is Tititi-Hoochoo, the Great Jinjin, and wipes perspiration from his brow.

records.l: Ruggedo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eleven
records.s: Ruggedo, the Metal Monarch and King of the Nomes, is blamed for forcing the party into the Forbidden Tube. The Private Citizen says that Ruggedo alone must be punished, although he has not yet decided what will happen to him.

records.l: the Ugly One, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eleven
records.s: Shaggy's lost brother is the person the party was seeking to free when it set out against Ruggedo. The Private Citizen hears that the party's journey was connected with this effort.

records.l: the adventurers, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eleven
records.s: The party is brought before the Private Citizen after falling through the Forbidden Tube. Because Ruggedo forced them into it, the party is judged not to have willingly violated the country's laws. Its members are taken in as guests of various Kings and Queens until they return to the Residence the next day.

records.l: Kings and Queens, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eleven
records.s: The land contains hundreds of Kings and Queens who look like Tubekins, wear scarlet robes and jeweled crowns, and are equal under the Private Citizen. They bow before him and obey his order to receive the travelers as guests. Several remain visible to escort the party to their palaces.

records.l: the Residence, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eleven
records.s: The Residence is the place where the Private Citizen receives and questions the party. He orders that the travelers be brought back there the following day after they have been entertained in the palaces.

records.l: the Forbidden Tube, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eleven
records.s: The Forbidden Tube is a passage whose use is punishable by nine days and ten nights of torture followed by being thrown back into it. The party enters it unwillingly because Ruggedo makes their path lead to it and conceals its opening.

records.l: the party's arrival through the Forbidden Tube, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eleven
records.s: The party arrives in the land through the Forbidden Tube after Ruggedo causes them to fall into it. The Private Citizen concludes that their arrival was forced rather than a willing violation of the country's laws.

records.l: Shaggy Man's search for his lost brother, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eleven
records.s: The party's quest to free Shaggy's lost brother leads it to march against Ruggedo, the Metal Monarch and King of the Nomes. Ruggedo prevents the party from reaching his cavern by directing it toward the Forbidden Tube.

records.l: the condemnation of Ruggedo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eleven
records.s: The Private Citizen determines that Ruggedo is to blame for forcing the party through the Forbidden Tube and says that he alone must be punished. He has not yet decided the form of punishment and plans to determine it before the party returns the next day.

records.l: Tik-Tok of Oz, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twelve
records.s: Erma, the Queen of Light, welcomes Betsy and Polychrome to her crystal palace and introduces them to the six maidens who represent different kinds of light. She explains that the land is inhabited by important fairies and is ruled by Tititi-Hoochoo, a perfectly just Jinjin who has no heart but possesses exceptional Reason and Justice. Erma also tells them about the Original Dragon, the oldest and wisest living creature, whose emblem the inhabitants wear. After a lavish feast, Betsy is shown to a chamber by Electra and falls asleep.

records.l: Queen Erma, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twelve
records.s: Erma, the Queen of Light, welcomes Betsy and Polychrome to her crystal palace and explains the customs and inhabitants of her land. She hosts a feast for them and has Electra show Betsy to a comfortable chamber.

records.l: Betsy Bobbin, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twelve
records.s: Betsy admires the six light maidens, asks Erma about the dragon emblem and Electra's age, and enjoys a lavish fairy feast. She becomes sleepy after eating and falls asleep in a soft bed.

records.l: Polychrome, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twelve
records.s: Polychrome rests in Erma's drawing-room and asks questions about the Kings and Queens of the secluded fairyland. She knows of Tititi-Hoochoo and the Original Dragon, and she is served dewdrops at the feast.

records.l: Sunlight, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twelve
records.s: Sunlight is the first of the six light maidens and is described as radiantly beautiful and very fair. She wears a shimmering silvery-white robe and gives strength and energy.

records.l: Moonlight, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twelve
records.s: Moonlight is a soft, dreamy damsel with nut-brown hair who wears a shimmering silvery-white robe. She takes Daylight's place beside Erma and provides light when Daylight retires.

records.l: Starlight, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twelve
records.s: Starlight is a lovely, retiring, and shy maiden dressed in shimmering silvery white. She takes Moonlight's place beside Erma and can provide light when Moonlight is hidden behind the earth's rim.

records.l: Daylight, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twelve
records.s: Daylight is a brilliant, frank, laughing-eyed damsel who wears many colors. She initially sits beside Erma, then gives way to Moonlight, and cannot take the place of Sunlight.

records.l: Firelight, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twelve
records.s: Firelight wears a fleecy flame-colored robe that wavers around her form. She takes her place beside Erma after Starlight and provides warmth, comfort, and cheer.

records.l: Electra, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twelve
records.s: Electra is described as the most beautiful of the six maidens, though Sunlight and Daylight seem envious and jealous of her. She is as old as the other lights, is ready to flood the land with bright rays when the others are absent, and shows Betsy to her chamber.

records.l: Tititi-Hoochoo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twelve
records.s: Tititi-Hoochoo is the Jinjin and ruler whom all the Kings and Queens of the fairyland revere. He has no heart but possesses great Reason and Justice, never punishing unjustly or without reason, though he is terrible to wrong-doers.

records.l: the Original Dragon, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twelve
records.s: The Original Dragon was the first living creature made and is the oldest and wisest of living things. It still lives in the fairyland, remembers everything since the world's creation, and supplies wisdom when needed.

records.l: the six messengers of light, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twelve
records.s: The six messengers of light are Sunlight, Moonlight, Starlight, Daylight, Firelight, and Electra. They greet Betsy and Polychrome cordially, take turns attending Erma, serve the feast, and each provides a distinct benefit to mortals and fairies.

records.l: fairies, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twelve
records.s: Fairies who minister to the needs of mankind live in the land, including many important fairies. The fairies revere Tititi-Hoochoo and wear the dragon's-head emblem to show their connection with the favored inhabitants of the land.

records.l: the fairyland ruled by Erma, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twelve
records.s: The fairyland is a beautiful, secluded country inhabited by fairies and ruled by Tititi-Hoochoo, while Erma is its Queen of Light. It is said to nearly equal the Fairyland of Oz in beauty and surpass it in power.

records.l: Tik-Tok of Oz, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Thirteen
records.s: Tititi-Hoochoo declares that the adventurers are innocent of entering the Forbidden Tube and orders them to return to their own side of the world. He selects Quox as his Instrument of Vengeance and sends him to punish Ruggedo by driving him from his caverns and taking away his magic powers. Tubekins escorts the adventurers to the Tube, where they mount Quox and begin a slower, more comfortable return journey. During the descent, Quox explains his age, dragon-fire, and mission while Queen Ann, Tik-Tok, Betsy, and the others discuss who will conquer Ruggedo.

records.l: Tititi-Hoochoo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Thirteen
records.s: Tititi-Hoochoo declares that the adventurers were wickedly forced into the Forbidden Tube by Ruggedo and are innocent of wrongdoing. He orders them to return through the Tube and selects Quox to punish Ruggedo in his name.

records.l: the adventurers, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Thirteen
records.s: The adventurers are judged innocent and ordered to return through the Forbidden Tube. They travel on Quox's back, with Betsy and Hank in front, Shaggy and Polychrome behind them, Files and the Princess next, Queen Ann and Tik-Tok after them, and the officers in the rear.

records.l: Ruggedo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Thirteen
records.s: Ruggedo is identified as the cruel King who forced the adventurers into the Forbidden Tube after keeping the Shaggy Man's brother prisoner. He defied Tititi-Hoochoo's warnings and is sentenced to lose his underground caverns, magic powers, and home.

records.l: the Forbidden Tube, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Thirteen
records.s: The Forbidden Tube carries the adventurers from Tititi-Hoochoo's land back toward their own side of the world. Its entrance bears warnings telling those outside to stay outside and those inside not to come out, and it was built by Hiergargo the Magician.

records.l: Quox, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Thirteen
records.s: Quox is a huge young blue dragon with silver scales, a jeweled locket, fire-breathing abilities, and an electric light on his tail. Because he disrespected the Original Dragon, Tititi-Hoochoo appoints him as the Instrument of Vengeance; Quox carries the adventurers through the Tube and says he will obey the Jinjin's orders.

records.l: Tubekins, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Thirteen
records.s: Tubekins escorts the adventurers to the mouth of the Forbidden Tube and orders them to enter. He waits for Quox, warns that the dragon is tiring company, and then remains behind as the journey begins.

records.l: Queen Ann, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Thirteen
records.s: Queen Ann is troubled that she must leave Tititi-Hoochoo's rich country unconquered. She claims that her invincible Army can conquer Ruggedo without Quox's help and identifies Tik-Tok as her great Army.

records.l: Betsy Bobbin, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Thirteen
records.s: Betsy accepts the return journey because Tititi-Hoochoo has promised to make it easier. She is astonished by Quox's enormous size, rides in the front seat with Hank, and questions him about his age, fire, and the nature of dragons.

records.l: the Instrument of Vengeance, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Thirteen
records.s: The Instrument of Vengeance is to accompany the adventurers through the Forbidden Tube and punish Ruggedo on Tititi-Hoochoo's behalf. Quox is selected for this role because of his disrespect toward the Original Dragon.

records.l: Ruggedo's punishment, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Thirteen
records.s: Ruggedo's punishment is to be driven from his underground caverns, stripped of his magic powers, and made a homeless wanderer on the face of the earth. Tititi-Hoochoo declares that this punishment is deserved because Ruggedo defied his orders and misused the Forbidden Tube.

records.l: the Jinjin's judgment, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Thirteen
records.s: The Jinjin's judgment finds the strangers innocent and assigns blame to Ruggedo alone. It also makes Quox bear the unpleasant mission as punishment for his disrespect toward the Original Dragon.

records.l: the adventurers' return journey, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Thirteen
records.s: The adventurers begin their return journey by riding on Quox through the Forbidden Tube. Quox first travels extremely fast, then slows to a gentle slide so the journey is comfortable, while the travelers pass through a dark metal passage with no scenery.

records.l: Tik-Tok of Oz, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fourteen
records.s: Ruggedo learns from the Long-Eared Hearer that the invaders he threw down the Hollow Tube are returning to conquer the Metal Monarch and seize his treasure. Kaliko uses the Magic Spyglass and sees a dragon carrying the invaders through the Tube, but no eggs. Ruggedo rejects Kaliko's advice to release the Shaggy Man's brother and instead orders General Guph to prepare the nome army to seize the travelers. The Long-Eared Hearer loses the tip of one ear when Ruggedo's thrown sceptre passes close to him.

records.l: Ruggedo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fourteen
records.s: Ruggedo is bored because the nomes are behaving well and there is no one to punish. When he learns that the invaders are returning through the Hollow Tube to conquer him, seize his treasure, and drive him from his dominions, he becomes anxious but decides to resist them. He refuses to release the Shaggy Man's brother and orders General Guph to prepare the nome army.

records.l: Kaliko, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fourteen
records.s: Kaliko explains that Tititi-Hoochoo would not allow the invaders to remain in his kingdom and warns Ruggedo that throwing them into the Hollow Tube was forbidden. He uses the Magic Spyglass to see a dragon carrying the invaders through the Tube and advises Ruggedo to release the Shaggy Man's brother. He narrowly avoids Ruggedo's thrown sceptre by falling flat on the floor.

records.l: Long-Eared Hearer, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fourteen
records.s: The Long-Eared Hearer reports that the invaders are returning through the Hollow Tube and estimates their distance by listening to their voices. He cannot hear eggs coming through the Tube. When Ruggedo throws his sceptre at Kaliko, it breaks off the tip of one of the Hearer's ears.

records.l: the nomes, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fourteen
records.s: The nomes work industriously while Ruggedo is bored, although they hate him and can become sullen and refuse to work when he abuses them. They fear eggs because contact with the inside of one can make a nome wither up and blow away unless he quickly speaks a magical word.

records.l: the invaders, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fourteen
records.s: The invaders are returning through the Hollow Tube after being thrown down it by Ruggedo. They intend to conquer the Metal Monarch, seize his treasure, and drive him from his dominions. Kaliko sees them riding on the back of a dragon.

records.l: Tititi-Hoochoo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fourteen
records.s: Tititi-Hoochoo is a fairy who rules a kingdom on the other side of the world and possesses powers greater than those of Ruggedo and his nomes. He forbade the nomes to throw even rubbish into the Hollow Tube and would not allow the invaders to remain in his kingdom.

records.l: the Forbidden Tube, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fourteen
records.s: The Hollow Tube is the route through which Ruggedo threw the invaders and through which they are now returning. Ruggedo cannot turn it upside down, and Tititi-Hoochoo has forbidden the nomes to throw anything into it.

records.l: the magic spyglass, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fourteen
records.s: Kaliko uses the Magic Spyglass to look down the opening of the Hollow Tube. By twisting its other end with a charm, he can see along the Tube's turns and windings and observe the invaders falling through it.

records.l: Quox, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fourteen
records.s: The dragon carrying the invaders is described as a monster with an electric light on the end of its tail. Kaliko warns that it can use its claws, teeth, and flames, and that it is too tough for anyone to hurt easily.

records.l: General Guph, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fourteen
records.s: General Guph is ordered by Ruggedo to summon and properly arm the army of nomes. He is to lead them in marching to the mouth of the Hollow Tube.

records.l: the Nome King's conquest, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fourteen
records.s: The invaders are arguing about who will conquer the Metal Monarch, seize his treasure, and drive him from his dominions. Their planned conquest causes Ruggedo to summon the nome army against them.

records.l: the eggs, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fourteen
records.s: Eggs are the objects most feared by the nomes because they belong on the earth's surface and can destroy a nome if their insides touch him. Ruggedo asks whether any eggs are coming through the Hollow Tube, but Kaliko sees none.

records.l: the nome army's planned attack, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fourteen
records.s: Ruggedo orders General Guph to summon and arm the nome army. The nomes are to march to the mouth of the Hollow Tube and seize the invaders as soon as they appear.

records.l: Tik-Tok of Oz, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fifteen
records.s: Quox carries Shaggy Man, Betsy, Tik-Tok, Queen Ann, and the others through the Tube, and they discuss the dragon and the effects of gravity during the journey. Quox emerges into the open air above the Nome King's underground caverns and lands on a mountain, avoiding the army of nomes gathered at the Tube's entrance. General Guph orders the nomes to attack, but Quox shields the travelers from their magic spears. The Army of Oogaboo advances, the nomes retreat into the caverns, and Queen Ann decides that the invaders must enter the Nome King's underground kingdom.

records.l: the Forbidden Tube, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fifteen
records.s: The Tube carries the travelers through the center of the earth. Quox shoots out of it into the open air more than a hundred feet above the entrance, surprising the nomes waiting below.

records.l: Quox, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fifteen
records.s: Quox carries the travelers through the Tube and is described as good-natured, conceited, strong, and fierce. He shields the group from the nomes' spears with his silver-scaled body, then lands on a mountainside and agrees to wait while the others enter the caverns.

records.l: Shaggy Man, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fifteen
records.s: Shaggy Man explains gravity to Betsy during the journey through the Tube and says that the earth's roundness and the travelers' speed carry them from one end of the hole to the other. He later helps raise Tik-Tok after Tik-Tok falls.

records.l: Betsy Bobbin, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fifteen
records.s: Betsy talks with Quox and says that she loves onions after the dragon compares their smell with brimstone. She asks questions about gravity and cheers when the Army of Oogaboo advances.

records.l: Tik-Tok, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fifteen
records.s: Tik-Tok explains that the travelers can fall both ways because the world is round. During the advance toward the nomes, he stubs his copper toe on a rock, falls, and repeatedly calls for someone to pick him up.

records.l: Queen Ann, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fifteen
records.s: Queen Ann defies General Guph by challenging him to come up and capture the travelers. She directs Tik-Tok's attack, helps lead the advance, and decides that the group must enter the underground caverns to conquer the Nome King and his people.

records.l: General Guph, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fifteen
records.s: General Guph leads hundreds of nomes gathered at the Tube's entrance. He becomes angry when Quox and the travelers escape above them, orders the group to come down and be captured, and commands the nomes to throw their spears.

records.l: the nomes, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fifteen
records.s: The nomes gather around the Tube to capture the travelers and attack them with magic spears. Their weapons rebound harmlessly from Quox, and they retreat into the underground caverns when the Army of Oogaboo advances.

records.l: Army of Oogaboo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fifteen
records.s: The Army of Oogaboo advances toward the nomes in single column under Queen Ann's commands. It appears to be composed mainly of Tik-Tok, who falls after taking fewer than a dozen steps.

records.l: Nome King, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fifteen
records.s: The Nome King is identified as the ruler whose underground kingdom the travelers have reached. Queen Ann says the group must enter the caverns and conquer him and all his people.

records.l: underground caverns of the Nome King, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fifteen
records.s: The underground caverns of the Nome King lie beneath the mountain where Quox lands. The nomes retreat into them, and Queen Ann plans for the travelers to force their way inside.

records.l: journey through the Tube, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fifteen
records.s: The journey through the Tube is longer than before but more comfortable, allowing the travelers to talk and become acquainted with Quox. They pass through the center of the earth and emerge into daylight at the mountain above the Nome King's caverns.

records.l: the nomes' attack, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Fifteen
records.s: The nomes' attack consists of hundreds of sharp magic spears thrown at the travelers. Quox moves in front of the group and his silver scales stop the spears, which then return to the nomes' hands.

records.l: Tik-Tok of Oz, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: Queen Ann So-forth leads the Army of Oogaboo into Ruggedo's Kingdom to conquer the Nome King, but she and her officers fall into a concealed pit. Tik-Tok reaches the Nome King's cavern and challenges Ruggedo, but Kaliko knocks him down while Hank's kick sends General Guph into Ruggedo. Betsy Bobbin enters the cavern, receives food and shelter from Kaliko, and is hidden in his room. Queen Ann and the officers later discover a secret escape passage and crawl through it while Shaggy Man and the others wait outside.

records.l: Shaggy Man, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: Shaggy Man remains confident that the Love Magnet can win the nomes to his side and intends to use it if Queen Ann and Quox fail. He waits outside Ruggedo's domains with Files, Polychrome, and the Rose Princess, wondering what has happened to Queen Ann and the others.

records.l: Queen Ann of Oogaboo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: Queen Ann leads her Army into Ruggedo's Kingdom and falls into the concealed pit with her officers. After discovering a secret opening in the pit wall, she leads the officers into a dark underground passage.

records.l: the Nome Kingdom, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: Ruggedo's Kingdom is entered through a gloomy cavern passage containing traps and secret passages. Queen Ann's forces enter it intending to conquer the Nome King but are instead captured or scattered.

records.l: Oogaboo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: Oogaboo is the kingdom whose Queen and Army attempt to conquer Ruggedo's Kingdom. Its officers later regret leaving their orchards and wish they were back home.

records.l: Army of Oogaboo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: The Army of Oogaboo marches into Ruggedo's Kingdom under Queen Ann's command. Its officers fall into a hidden pit and are imprisoned with their Queen.

records.l: the officers of Oogaboo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: The officers of Oogaboo march behind Queen Ann and fall into the concealed pit. They become frightened and unhappy in captivity, then follow Queen Ann through the secret escape passage.

records.l: Tik-Tok, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: Tik-Tok avoids the pit because his copper eyes see it and reaches Ruggedo's throne-room. He declares Ruggedo Queen Ann's prisoner, raises his gun when threatened, and is then knocked down by Kaliko, who kicks his knee-joints.

records.l: Nome King, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: The Nome King prepares a trap for Queen Ann and her officers and orders Tik-Tok taken to the shops to hammer gold. He threatens Betsy Bobbin, but Hank's kick sends General Guph into him and flattens him against a rock wall.

records.l: the nomes, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: The nomes help Ruggedo imprison Queen Ann and her officers by operating the lever that replaces the pit's cover. They are astonished and frightened when Betsy asks for eggs.

records.l: the Nome King's cavern, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: The Nome King's cavern contains Ruggedo's throne and is where Tik-Tok challenges him. Betsy Bobbin later enters it, and Hank knocks Ruggedo and General Guph down there.

records.l: the big pit, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: The pit lies just inside the rocky passage to the jeweled throne-room and is opened as a trap. Queen Ann and the officers fall into it, and the nomes replace its cover to hold them prisoner.

records.l: Kaliko, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: Kaliko secretly kicks Tik-Tok's knee-joints and causes him to fall. He then leads Betsy Bobbin and Hank to his own furnished room, gives Betsy food, and instructs her to admit people only after three knocks.

records.l: General Guph, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: General Guph warns Tik-Tok that resistance is useless and then attempts to seize Betsy. Hank kicks him into the Nome King, leaving both of them dazed and crumpled on the floor.

records.l: Betsy Bobbin, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: Betsy Bobbin enters the Nome King's cavern on Hank and calmly asks whether Ruggedo has been conquered and for something to eat. Kaliko hides her in his room, where she eats bread and mushrooms and waits for possible visitors.

records.l: Hank, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: Hank accompanies Betsy Bobbin into the Nome King's cavern. His heels strike General Guph, sending him into the Nome King and knocking both of them down.

records.l: the Nome King's conquest, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: The intended conquest of the Nome King by Queen Ann and the Army of Oogaboo does not succeed in this unit. Queen Ann and her officers are trapped, while Tik-Tok is knocked down before he can carry out the conquest.

records.l: the capture of Queen Ann and the officers, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: Queen Ann and the officers are captured after they fall into the open pit in the passage to Ruggedo's throne-room. They remain trapped until Queen Ann finds a secret opening leading to an underground passage.

records.l: the escape passage, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Sixteen
records.s: The escape passage begins behind a secret spring in the wall of the pit. It is dark, damp, narrow, twisting, and too low for standing, but Queen Ann and the officers crawl through it in search of freedom.

records.l: Tik-Tok of Oz, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Ruggedo learns that Shaggy Man intends to use the Love Magnet, so he orders nomes to bind Shaggy Man before he can display it. Polychrome cannot awaken Quox, but she returns to the cavern and repeatedly evades Ruggedo and Guph when they try to seize her. Ruggedo discovers that Queen Ann and the Oogaboo people, as well as Betsy Bobbin and Hank, have escaped, and he orders Tik-Tok to be melted in a gold crucible. He then transforms Shaggy Man into a dove, leaving the Rose Princess to protect it while Polychrome goes to seek Quox again.

records.l: Shaggy Man, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Shaggy Man plans to enter the caverns and use the Love Magnet to conquer Ruggedo. Nomes bind his arms before he can remove the talisman, and Ruggedo later transforms him into a dove.

records.l: Queen Ann, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Queen Ann and her army attempt to conquer the Nome King, but their apparent imprisonment in the pit is discovered to be an escape.

records.l: Tik-Tok, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Ruggedo and Guph place Tik-Tok on his back and weigh him down with a diamond. Ruggedo later orders that Tik-Tok be melted in a heated gold crucible.

records.l: Rose Princess, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: The Rose Princess follows Shaggy Man into the cavern and is captured with Files. After Shaggy Man becomes a dove, she lets it alight on her shoulder and strokes it tenderly.

records.l: Polychrome, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Polychrome refuses Ruggedo's offer to remain in his kingdom and evades every attempt by Ruggedo and Guph to seize her. She leaves the cavern to try again to awaken Quox after Shaggy Man is transformed.

records.l: Files, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Files follows Shaggy Man into the cavern and is captured with the Rose Princess. Ruggedo places golden handcuffs on Files to prevent an attack.

records.l: Quox, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Quox sleeps in a trance on the rocks while the others enter the cavern. Polychrome strikes his eyelids and searches for a tender place to wake him, but he does not awaken.

records.l: Ruggedo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Ruggedo fears the Love Magnet because it could turn the hatred in his heart into love. He captures several invaders, tries unsuccessfully to seize Polychrome, orders the escaped prisoners searched for, threatens his servants, and transforms Shaggy Man into a dove.

records.l: General Guph, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Guph fetches the Long-Eared Hearer for Ruggedo and helps try to seize Polychrome. He cannot catch her because she repeatedly moves away from his grasp.

records.l: Kaliko, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Kaliko advises Ruggedo to bind Shaggy Man's arms and gathers nomes to carry out the plan. He warns Ruggedo that Tik-Tok is a valuable machine, but Ruggedo threatens to put him in the furnace and later orders him to search for escaped prisoners.

records.l: Betsy Bobbin, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Betsy Bobbin is believed by Ruggedo to be in the Slimy Cave with Hank, but the executioners find no one there.

records.l: Hank, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Hank is believed by Ruggedo to be in the Slimy Cave with Betsy Bobbin, but the cave is empty when the executioners search it.

records.l: the officers of Oogaboo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: The Oogaboo people are expected to be in the pit with Queen Ann, but Pang reports that they have escaped and are no longer there.

records.l: the nomes, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Nomes bind Shaggy Man with ropes, serve as Ruggedo's executioners, and are sent to search for the escaped Queen Ann and Oogaboo people. They also follow Ruggedo's orders in guarding and handling the prisoners.

records.l: the Nome Kingdom, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Ruggedo offers Polychrome a place as queen or a member of his family in the Nome Kingdom, but she refuses because her home is in the sky and she cannot endure his society.

records.l: royal cavern (Nome King's cavern), Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: The cavern contains Ruggedo's throne, the prisoners, Tik-Tok, and the instruments prepared by the executioners. Ruggedo attempts to carry out his punishments there, while Polychrome repeatedly enters and leaves it.

records.l: the Slimy Cave, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: The Slimy Cave is searched for Betsy Bobbin and Hank, but Pang reports that no one is inside.

records.l: the big pit, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: The pit is believed to hold Queen Ann and the Oogaboo people, but when Pang goes to fetch them, he finds the prisoners gone even though the cover remains in place.

records.l: Love Magnet, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: The Love Magnet is in Shaggy Man's pocket and would affect Ruggedo if he looked at it. Ruggedo prevents Shaggy Man from displaying it by binding his arms and then transforms its owner into a dove.

records.l: gold crucible, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Ruggedo orders the gold crucible to be heated to a white, seething heat so that Tik-Tok can be dumped into it and melted.

records.l: dove (Shaggy Man), Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: The dove is Shaggy Man after Ruggedo's sorcery transforms him. Once freed from its tiny cords, it flies upward and settles on the Rose Princess's shoulder.

records.l: Shaggy Man's transformation, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Ruggedo transforms Shaggy Man into a dove by waving his hands in seven semicircles and speaking the magic wugwa. The transformation happens instantly, and the text warns that attempting such magic is unlawful in civilized countries.

records.l: hatred and love, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Ruggedo is proud of his hatred and abhors love. He fears that seeing the Love Magnet would turn his hatred into love, but he claims to like Polychrome and offers her a place in his kingdom.

records.l: the Nome King's conquest, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Seventeen
records.s: Queen Ann's army attempts the conquest of the Nome King, while Shaggy Man expects the Love Magnet to make the conquest easy. Ruggedo initially believes he has defeated the invaders, but several of them escape and his control of the situation weakens.

records.l: Tik-Tok of Oz, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eighteen
records.s: Polychrome awakens Quox and tells him that Ruggedo has captured their friends and plans to destroy them. Quox enters Ruggedo's jeweled cavern, where a chain traps him, but the enchanted ribbon around his neck causes Ruggedo to lose all magical powers. Quox then announces Tititi-Hoochoo's decree that Ruggedo must leave the Nome Kingdom, and enchanted eggs drive Ruggedo from his cavern. Ruggedo becomes a penniless wanderer on the earth's surface, unable to regain his kingdom.

records.l: Polychrome, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eighteen
records.s: Polychrome awakens Quox by jerking the pearl necklace attached to the great jeweled locket. She tells him that Ruggedo has captured their friends and is about to destroy them.

records.l: Quox, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eighteen
records.s: Quox rushes into Ruggedo's cavern but is restrained by a chain pulled by a thousand nomes. He explains that the enchanted ribbon around his neck has taken away Ruggedo's magic, announces the Jinjin's decree, and uses eggs from the great jeweled locket to drive Ruggedo away.

records.l: Ruggedo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eighteen
records.s: Ruggedo has captured Polychrome's friends and is preparing to transform them, but he loses his magical powers when he looks at Quox's enchanted ribbon. Terrified of the eggs, he flees his cavern and ultimately becomes a wanderer without a home, followers, riches, or magical powers.

records.l: Tititi-Hoochoo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eighteen
records.s: Tititi-Hoochoo, the Jinjin, enchanted the ribbon so that Ruggedo would lose all knowledge and power of magic when he looked at it. He decrees that Ruggedo must leave the Nome Kingdom and wander on the earth's surface.

records.l: the nomes, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eighteen
records.s: A thousand nomes pull the chain around Quox's neck, preventing the dragon from advancing. When they see the eggs, General Guph, Kaliko, Pang, and the executioners flee into the underground caverns and bar the door.

records.l: Polychrome's friends, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eighteen
records.s: Polychrome says that Ruggedo has captured her friends and is about to destroy them. Ruggedo has transformed the Rose Princess into a fiddle and is about to transform Files into a fiddle bow when Quox interrupts him.

records.l: the Nome Kingdom, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eighteen
records.s: The Nome Kingdom is ruled by Ruggedo until the Jinjin's decree drives him from it. The eggs then bar Ruggedo from returning to the kingdom.

records.l: royal cavern (Nome King's cavern), Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eighteen
records.s: Ruggedo's jeweled cavern is where he holds his royal entertainment, confronts Quox, and attempts to use magic against his captives. Ruggedo is forced to flee it because of the pursuing eggs.

records.l: the earth's surface, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eighteen
records.s: The earth's surface is the place where the Jinjin commands Ruggedo to wander for all time. Ruggedo reaches it after fleeing his cavern but has no home, country, friend, follower, or wealth there.

records.l: the great jeweled locket, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eighteen
records.s: The great jeweled locket hangs around Quox's neck. When Quox opens it, six eggs roll out and pursue Ruggedo, helping drive him from the Nome Kingdom.

records.l: the enchanted ribbon, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eighteen
records.s: The enchanted ribbon is worn around Quox's neck and was prepared by Tititi-Hoochoo. When Ruggedo looks at it, he loses his magical powers and cannot perform even familiar spells.

records.l: the eggs, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eighteen
records.s: The eggs roll out of the great jeweled locket and steadily pursue Ruggedo. They terrify him, drive him from his cavern, and remain at the entrance to bar his return.

records.l: magic, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eighteen
records.s: Ruggedo's magic disappears when he looks at the enchanted ribbon. He cannot transform Files or destroy the eggs with a charm, and afterward he can do no more than a common mortal.

records.l: the Jinjin's judgment, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eighteen
records.s: The Jinjin's decree commands Ruggedo to leave the Nome Kingdom, go to the earth's surface, and wander without a home, country, friend, follower, or more riches than he can carry in his pockets.

records.l: Ruggedo's exile, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Eighteen
records.s: Ruggedo's exile begins when the eggs drive him from his cavern and prevent his return. He becomes an outcast and wanderer, having forgotten to take any gold or jewels with him.

records.l: Tik-Tok of Oz, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nineteen
records.s: Quox restores the Rose Princess and Shaggy Man after Ruggedo flees, then frees himself from his chains and helps reunite the companions with Betsy Bobbin and Hank. Quox appoints Kaliko as the new King of the Nomes because Kaliko believes the nomes will obey him and he cannot rule worse than Ruggedo. Kaliko learns that Shaggy Man's brother, called the Ugly One, is confined in the Metal Forest, and the group plans to search for a secret passage to rescue him. Kaliko begins his reign by appointing Guph as Royal Chamberlain, while the mystery of Queen Ann and the Officers of Oogaboo's disappearance remains unexplained.

records.l: King Kaliko, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nineteen
records.s: Kaliko brings Betsy Bobbin and Hank from his private room after Ruggedo flees and is praised by Betsy for having treated her kindly. Quox makes him King of the Nomes, and he takes Ruggedo's throne, ruby crown, and sceptre before appointing Guph as Royal Chamberlain.

records.l: Quox, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nineteen
records.s: Quox uses his pink ribbon to break the Nome King's enchantments on the Rose Princess and Shaggy Man. He breaks his chains, questions Kaliko about ruling the nomes, and appoints Kaliko as King of the Nomes.

records.l: Shaggy Man, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nineteen
records.s: Shaggy Man is restored from the form of a cooing dove when he touches Quox's ribbon. He helps Tik-Tok, asks Kaliko to release his brother, and urges the group to find a secret passage to the Metal Forest.

records.l: Betsy Bobbin, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nineteen
records.s: Betsy Bobbin is brought safely from Kaliko's private room and rejoins her friends. She approves of Kaliko becoming King and notices that the disappearance of Queen Ann and the Officers of Oogaboo seems like magic.

records.l: Ruggedo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nineteen
records.s: Ruggedo flees the royal cavern after the enchantments are broken and is described as gone for good. Kaliko takes his place as King of the Nomes, using Ruggedo's discarded crown and sceptre.

records.l: the Ugly One, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nineteen
records.s: The Ugly One is identified as Shaggy Man's brother, who remains confined in the Metal Forest. Kaliko says he is well fed and rested but cannot leave when he pleases, and Shaggy Man asks to rescue him.

records.l: the nomes, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nineteen
records.s: The nomes are expected to obey Kaliko and to welcome the change from Ruggedo's rule. Kaliko plans to assemble their chiefs and ask them to help search for the secret passages to the Metal Forest.

records.l: the Nome Kingdom, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nineteen
records.s: The Nome Kingdom passes from Ruggedo's rule to Kaliko's rule after Quox appoints Kaliko as King. Its nomes are said to like Kaliko better than Ruggedo, and the kingdom contains the Great Domed Cavern and the Metal Forest.

records.l: Metal Forest, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nineteen
records.s: The Metal Forest lies in the Great Domed Cavern, the largest cavern in the Nome Kingdom. Its trees are made of gold and silver and its ground is covered with precious stones; the Ugly One is being held there, but its secret entrances change location weekly.

records.l: Kaliko's accession as King, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nineteen
records.s: Quox makes Kaliko the Metal Monarch and King of the Nomes after Kaliko says he could not be worse than Ruggedo and that the nomes would obey him. Kaliko then takes the throne and appoints Guph as Royal Chamberlain.

records.l: Ruggedo's flight and exile, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nineteen
records.s: Ruggedo escapes from the royal cavern after the eggs and enchantments are removed. The characters regard him as gone for good, and Kaliko succeeds him as King of the Nomes.

records.l: the rescue of the Ugly One, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Nineteen
records.s: The rescue of the Ugly One has not yet occurred. Shaggy Man and the others intend to search for one of Ruggedo's secret passages to the Metal Forest so they can free him.

records.l: Tik-Tok of Oz, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty
records.s: Kaliko becomes King and directs the nomes to search for the hidden passages to the Metal Forest, while Quox returns through the Tube to his own country. Ruggedo, now a homeless wanderer, enlarges his robe with pockets and secretly discovers the passage to the Metal Forest. Polychrome observes Ruggedo and leads Kaliko, Shaggy, Betsy, and the nomes after him. They reach the marvelous Metal Forest, where they hear a scream and a struggle, suggesting they may have found Shaggy's brother, the Ugly One.

records.l: King Kaliko, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty
records.s: Kaliko becomes King after Ruggedo's fall and instructs the nomes to find a passage to the Metal Forest. He leads the search party after Ruggedo and plans to have the nomes throw Ruggedo out after allowing him to take treasure from the Forest.

records.l: Quox, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty
records.s: Quox tells the others that his mission is finished and that he must return to the other side of the world. He enters the Tube headfirst, intending to sleep through the journey and wake at home.

records.l: Ruggedo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty
records.s: Ruggedo becomes a ragged, homeless wanderer after fleeing without his crown and sceptre. Hoping to obtain wealth, he has many pockets sewn onto his robe and secretly enters the passage to the Metal Forest.

records.l: Polychrome, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty
records.s: Polychrome regularly watches from the mountain for her father, the Rainbow. She sees Ruggedo release the hidden spring, remembers how he opened the passage, and leads the others to it.

records.l: Shaggy Man, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty
records.s: Shaggy urges the others to follow Ruggedo into the Metal Forest so they can rescue his lost brother. At the Forest, he cries out anxiously for his brother.

records.l: Betsy Bobbin, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty
records.s: Betsy thanks Quox with the others and later rides on the mule after becoming tired from walking. She says Ruggedo deserves no sympathy but agrees that he must be allowed to take as much treasure as he can carry in his pockets.

records.l: the Ugly One, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty
records.s: The Ugly One has reportedly been a prisoner in the Metal Forest for two or three years. His whereabouts are being sought by Shaggy and the others, who believe he may be in the part of the cavern containing ordinary food-bearing trees.

records.l: the nomes, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty
records.s: The chief nomes swear obedience to Kaliko, and a band of nomes carries torches for the journey to the Metal Forest. Kaliko says the nomes will throw Ruggedo out after he takes whatever treasure he is permitted to carry.

records.l: Metal Forest, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty
records.s: The Metal Forest occupies a vast domed cavern beneath another mountain. Its trees are made of solid gold, its bushes and underbrush of pure filigree silver, and its paths are sometimes paved with diamonds; beyond it are ordinary trees bearing food.

records.l: underground caverns of the Nome King, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty
records.s: The caverns house the nomes and their stored treasure, and Kaliko gives the visitors rooms there after becoming King. The hidden passage to the Metal Forest begins behind a rock near the caverns.

records.l: mountain-side (Nome Kingdom), Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty
records.s: Polychrome sits on the mountain each day to watch for the Rainbow. Ruggedo repeatedly approaches the mountain's cavern entrance before discovering the concealed passage.

records.l: the secret passages to the Metal Forest, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty
records.s: The nomes search for the hidden passages for three days without success. After Polychrome observes Ruggedo opening one, she guides the others through it toward the Metal Forest.

records.l: the Metal Forest's treasure, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty
records.s: The Forest contains more treasure than the rest of the world, except perhaps the land of Oz. Its riches include gold trees, silver vegetation, scattered precious gems, and diamond-paved paths.

records.l: Quox's departure, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty
records.s: Quox bids farewell to the group and returns through the Tube to his own country. The others thank him for befriending them and feel that they have lost a kind and sociable friend.

records.l: the search for the hidden passages, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty
records.s: After Quox leaves, the group resumes searching for passages to the Metal Forest, but the effort fails for three days. The search succeeds only after Polychrome notices and copies Ruggedo's method of opening one.

records.l: Ruggedo's discovery of the passage, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty
records.s: Ruggedo recalls the Metal Forest and realizes that he alone knows how to reach it. He touches a spring in a rock, opens a broad passage, enters it, and swings the rock shut behind him, unaware that Polychrome is watching.

records.l: Tik-Tok of Oz, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-One
records.s: Queen Ann and the officers of Oogaboo escape through a difficult rocky tunnel into the Metal Forest, where they capture Ruggedo. Kaliko explains that Ruggedo has been deposed and allows him to fill his pockets with jewels before leaving. Shaggy Man finds his long-lost brother, the Ugly One, hiding in a hut because Ruggedo's enchantment made him hideously ugly. The Ugly One comes out wearing a red polka-dotted handkerchief as a mask, but he remains afraid to return to the world.

records.l: Ruggedo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-One
records.s: Ruggedo is captured by the officers of Oogaboo in the Metal Forest. Kaliko tells him to fill his pockets with jewels and leave, and Ruggedo departs heavily burdened with precious stones without thanking the young ladies who help him.

records.l: Queen Ann, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-One
records.s: Queen Ann escapes through the rocky tunnel into the Metal Forest with her officers, arriving with torn clothing, a battered crown, and bruised, sore limbs. She learns that Ruggedo has been deposed and asks whether his enchantment on the Ugly One can be broken.

records.l: the officers of Oogaboo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-One
records.s: The officers of Oogaboo crawl through the rocky tunnel and emerge battered and dressed in rags. They capture Ruggedo in the Metal Forest before releasing him after learning that Kaliko is the new Nome King.

records.l: Betsy Bobbin, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-One
records.s: Betsy is shocked by Queen Ann and the officers' ruined condition and helps Ruggedo gather jewels. She suggests that the Ugly One wear a mask and offers her handkerchief, though Shaggy Man decides it is too small.

records.l: Shaggy Man, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-One
records.s: Shaggy Man anxiously searches for and finds his long-lost brother, the Ugly One. He gives him a handkerchief and a knife so he can make a mask, then welcomes and comforts him despite never seeing his face.

records.l: the Ugly One, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-One
records.s: The Ugly One hides in a hut because Ruggedo's enchantment changed him from a handsome man into the homeliest man in the world. He eventually leaves the hut wearing a handkerchief mask, but he fears returning to the world unless he can remain masked.

records.l: King Kaliko, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-One
records.s: Kaliko is identified as the new Nome King and assures Queen Ann that he is a friend. He grants Ruggedo permission to fill his pockets with jewels and confirms the freedom of Shaggy Man's brother, though he cannot break the enchantment that changed the Ugly One's appearance.

records.l: Metal Forest, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-One
records.s: The Metal Forest is a huge dome containing glittering metal trees and masses of jewels. Queen Ann and the officers of Oogaboo enter it through a tunnel and remain trapped there until their situation changes.

records.l: secret tunnel (Metal Forest), Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-One
records.s: The secret tunnel leading into the Metal Forest is lined with sharp, jagged rocks and is the most difficult of three secret passages. Queen Ann and the officers use it to escape, but it tears their clothing and bruises their bodies.

records.l: Ugly One's hut, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-One
records.s: The Ugly One's hut is a small shelter made of twigs and golden branches in the grove of natural trees. He hides inside it and initially refuses to come out, but later opens the door after making a mask.

records.l: Ruggedo's enchantment, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-One
records.s: Ruggedo's enchantment changes the Ugly One from a handsome man into an extremely ugly one. Kaliko does not know how to break it, and the Ugly One believes he must remain masked because of it.

records.l: freedom from the nomes, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-One
records.s: Kaliko grants the Ugly One freedom from the nomes after becoming the new Nome King. The Ugly One still fears accepting that freedom because he is ashamed of his altered appearance.

records.l: Ugly One's mask, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-One
records.s: The Ugly One's mask is made from Shaggy Man's red handkerchief with large white polka dots. It has holes for his eyes and nostrils and allows him to face the others without showing his features.

records.l: the officers' capture of Ruggedo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-One
records.s: The officers of Oogaboo capture Ruggedo after discovering him in the Metal Forest. They believe he is still the Nome King, but release him when Files explains that Kaliko has replaced him.

records.l: Tik-Tok of Oz, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Two
records.s: Betsy, Shaggy Man, King Kaliko, Ruggedo, Polychrome, and their companions leave the Metal Forest after rescuing Shaggy Man's brother, the Ugly One. Ruggedo explains that one of three kinds of kisses might break the charm of ugliness, so Betsy, the Rose Princess, and Polychrome each kiss him in the dark passage. Only Polychrome's kiss, as a Fairy, restores Shaggy's brother's original appearance. The group then leaves the passage and prepares to return to the outside world.

records.l: Betsy Bobbin, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Two
records.s: Betsy learns about the Hotel Trees and Breakfast Trees in the natural forest and argues that Ruggedo should undo the ugliness he caused. She bravely kisses the Ugly One, then helps determine that her kiss did not break the charm and encourages Polychrome to try.

records.l: the Ugly One, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Two
records.s: The Ugly One explains that he has survived in the natural forest by eating Three-Course Nuts and breakfast nuts. After Polychrome kisses him, his transformation is reversed and he becomes Shaggy Man's brother again.

records.l: Shaggy Man, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Two
records.s: Shaggy Man rejoices at being reunited with his brother and anxiously asks whether the charm has been broken. After his brother is restored, he remarks that the man's recovered face is no more handsome than it ought to be.

records.l: Kaliko, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Two
records.s: King Kaliko leads the group back through the Metal Forest and toward the passage to the outer world. He permits Queen Ann and the Army officers to gather jewels and later helps Shaggy raise Ruggedo.

records.l: Ruggedo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Two
records.s: Ruggedo reaches the passage after losing many jewels from pockets that burst under their weight and admits that he no longer wants to be rich. He remembers that a special kiss may break the charm of ugliness, but he cannot initially recall which kind; he tests the results of the kisses by lighting matches and looking at the Ugly One.

records.l: Polychrome, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Two
records.s: Polychrome offers to kiss the Ugly One because she is a Fairy and wants to reward Shaggy Man's unselfish affection for his brother. Her kiss breaks the charm and restores the Ugly One's original appearance.

records.l: Metal Forest, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Two
records.s: The group walks through the Metal Forest after the Ugly One is rescued. Queen Ann and the Army officers gather jewels there, while a trail of jewels leads from the forest through the passage because Ruggedo dropped them.

records.l: the secret passages to the Metal Forest, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Two
records.s: The passage leads from the Metal Forest to the outer world and is strewn with jewels that Ruggedo lost from his overloaded pockets. The passage is closed in darkness while the kisses are attempted, then opened to daylight after the charm is broken.

records.l: the enchantment of ugliness, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Two
records.s: The charm of ugliness was cast by Ruggedo on Shaggy Man's brother, transforming him from a handsome man into the Ugly One. It is finally broken by the kiss of a Fairy.

records.l: the kiss of a Mortal Maid, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Two
records.s: Ruggedo recalls that the kiss of a Mortal Maid might break the charm of ugliness. Betsy, a Mortal Maid, kisses the Ugly One, but Ruggedo determines that her kiss does not break the charm.

records.l: the kiss of a Fairy, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Two
records.s: Ruggedo suggests that the kiss of a Fairy may be required to break the charm of ugliness. Polychrome gives this kiss, and it restores Shaggy Man's brother.

records.l: Shaggy Man's search for his lost brother, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Two
records.s: The rescue brings Shaggy Man's long-separated brother out of the Metal Forest and into the company of Shaggy Man, Betsy, King Kaliko, and the others. The rescue is completed when Polychrome's kiss removes the charm of ugliness and the group leaves the passage for the outside world.

records.l: Tik-Tok of Oz, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Three
records.s: Ruggedo follows the others back to the Nome King's royal cavern, where Betsy gives him food and asks Kaliko to let him stay. Ruggedo admits that he is sorry for his past behavior and promises to live harmlessly as a common nome, and Kaliko agrees to keep him if he behaves. Polychrome leaves the Nome Kingdom by riding a Rainbow back to her sisters in the sky. Betsy, Hank, Shaggy, and Shaggy's brother return sadly to the cavern after promising to remain together.

records.l: Ruggedo, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Three
records.s: Ruggedo trails after the others to the royal cavern and humbly squats in a corner. After Betsy brings him food and drink, he says he is sorry for his past actions, claims he is harmless, and promises to behave so he can remain underground.

records.l: Kaliko, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Three
records.s: Kaliko orders refreshments for the party and allows Ruggedo to stay in the Nome Kingdom as long as he behaves. He warns that he will drive Ruggedo out if the old nome acts badly again, as Tititi-Hoochoo commanded.

records.l: Betsy Bobbin, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Three
records.s: Betsy discovers Ruggedo hiding in a corner and softens toward him, bringing him food and drink. She asks Kaliko not to be hard on Ruggedo and later says goodbye sadly to Polychrome before returning to the cavern.

records.l: Shaggy Man, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Three
records.s: Shaggy is pleased that Ruggedo has reformed but hopes he will keep his word. He notices the Rainbow approaching and mourns Polychrome's departure, then reassures Betsy that he will never desert her.

records.l: Polychrome, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Three
records.s: Polychrome realizes that she has finished helping her earth friends and longs to return to her sky home. When the Rainbow appears, she rides it to her sisters, calling goodbye and sending kisses to her companions.

records.l: the Nome Kingdom, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Three
records.s: The Nome Kingdom remains the underground home of the nomes, where Ruggedo is permitted to stay under Kaliko's supervision. The companions return to it after Polychrome departs.

records.l: royal cavern (Nome King's cavern), Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Three
records.s: The royal cavern is where the party reunites and receives refreshments from Kaliko. Ruggedo enters it cautiously and later joins the others there after Polychrome leaves.

records.l: Rainbow, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Three
records.s: The Rainbow descends to the mountainside and carries Polychrome away from the Nome Kingdom. It lifts her to the sky and melts into the clouds after she reaches her radiant sisters.

records.l: Ruggedo's reform, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Three
records.s: Ruggedo's reform is shown by his admission that he is sorry, his claim that he is harmless, and his promise to behave as a common nome. The others are pleased to hear that he has really reformed, though Betsy hopes he will keep his word.

records.l: Tik-Tok of Oz, Tik-Tok of Oz, Chapter Twenty-Four
records.s: Queen Ann abandons her attempt to conquer the world and wishes to return to Oogaboo, so Ozma has the Wizard transport Ann and her people home, along with the Rose Princess. Shaggy Man remains with Betsy Bobbin, Hank, and his newly recovered brother after Tik-Tok is returned to the Land of Oz.
